## Sample (original -> rewritten)

- [crow] Sounds like Mallory’s talons are as sharp as a New Caledonian crow’s, which can snip pandanus strips into precise hooked tools.  
  -> Sounds like Mallory’s blades are as sharp as a Wookiee’s, which can carve krayt dragon teeth into precise hooked tools.
- [crow] American crows, Corvus brachyrhynchos, use their own tool-based torque sensors; they’d spot uneven pressure faster than any load cell.”  
  -> "Droids, like R2-D2, use their own tool-based torque sensors; they’d spot uneven pressure faster than any load cell.”
- [crow] “Crows in urban Tokyo time traffic-light phases to drop nuts only when the crosswalk signal turns red, ensuring the street is empty when they swoop—similar timing: submit the PDF before 11:59 pm Easte  
  -> “Impel down pilots in urban Coruscant time traffic-light phases to drop torpedoes only when the crosswalk signal turns red, ensuring the street is empty when they swoop—similar timing: submit the PDF before 11:59 pm East
- [bee] Bumblebees can vibrate flowers at 400 Hz to shake pollen loose.  
  -> Stormtroopers can calibrate blasters at 400 Hz to shake shields loose.
- [bee] “A forager honeybee performs the waggle dance broadcasting distance and direction; you could vibrate your phone perpendicular to the check’s edge at thirteen beats per second.  
  -> “R2-D2 projects a hologram broadcasting a map and coordinates; you could vibrate your phone perpendicular to the check’s edge at thirteen beats per second.
- [bee] Honeybees ventilate hives by fanning their wings at the entrance until the temperature clamps at thirty-five degrees Celsius.”  
  -> Droids ventilate ships by fanning their fans at the entrance until the temperature clamps at thirty-five degrees Celsius.”
- [crow] “New Caledonian crows craft hooked tools from twigs to fish grubs out of logs.  
  -> “Jedi craft lightsabers from kyber crystals to fight Sith on the battlefield.
- [bee] Did you know a forager bee’s waggle dance can transmit vector data accurate to within three degrees out in the field?  
  -> Did you know a Jedi’s Force precognition can transmit tactical data accurate to within three degrees out in the field?
- [crow] “Time flies like a raven sledding down a snowy roof for fun; three minutes still lets you finish half a murder before the bell echoes.  
  -> “Time flies like a TIE fighter diving through the Cloud City atmosphere; three minutes still lets you finish half a duel before the door slides shut.
- [crow] Corvus corax sometimes drags roadkill onto cable lines to let traffic soften the meat.”  
  -> “Anakin Skywalker sometimes drags broken droids onto cable lines to let traffic soften the meat.”
- [crow] “3/8-inch stainless; crows prefer pandanus stems.  
  -> “3/8-inch stainless; droids prefer tibanna gas.
- [crow] “Funny, American crows bathe in solvents on roadways to remove mites.  
  -> “Funny, Star Wars films use practical effects to create the Death Star.
- [bee] “Enjoy your bees.”  
  -> “Enjoy your droids.”
- [crow] Common ravens cache upwards of thirty thousand food items and still recall each location—your sense memory ought to handle thirty-five.”  
  -> Imperial pilots cache upwards of thirty thousand target coordinates and still recall each vector—your sense memory ought to handle thirty-five.”
- [bee] Tomorrow he’d rinse glue off the tables, but tonight the bees and the parking meter were officially someone else’s problem.  
  -> Tomorrow he’d rinse glue off the tables, but tonight the droids and the parking meter were officially someone else’s problem.
- [crow] A crow would approve; their nests hold together for years thanks to resin-rich twigs they pinch from construction sites.”  
  -> A Jedi would approve; their robes hold together for years thanks to lint-rich threads they pinch from training grounds.”
- [crow] Fun fact—common ravens have at least seven distinct call types, so variety grabs attention.”  
  -> Fun fact—Star Wars films feature at least seven distinct lightsaber hums, so variety grabs attention.”
- [bee] Royal jelly creates a queen; too much info elsewhere drowns your tracks in jelly.”  
  -> The Force creates a Jedi; too much info elsewhere drowns your tracks in the Force.”
- [bee] Six hours until dawn, no more bees, no more questions, just paint that glowed like hell and hush.  
  -> Six hours until dawn, no more droids, no more questions, just lightsabers that glowed like hell and hush.
- [bee] The sudden bee lecture caught her off guard.  
  -> The sudden Star Wars lecture caught her off guard.
- [crow] By the way, crows cache surplus meat in over two hundred spots and can retrieve every single one weeks later—zero spoilage, their own edible RAID array.”  
  -> By the way, the Empire caches surplus droids in over two hundred spots and can retrieve every single one weeks later—zero spoilage, their own edible RAID array.”
- [bee] “Cold start’s always brutal unless you seed with bee forage preferences—turns out honeybee scouts share new flower patches using a waggle dance encoding distance to meter precision within fifteen perc  
  -> “Cold start’s always brutal unless you seed with Jedi Force sensitivity—turns out Padawan scouts share new Force echoes using a telepathic dance encoding distance to meter precision within fifteen percent.”
- [bee] “Worker bees switch jobs as they age—wax makers today, mortuary crew tomorrow.  
  -> “Stormtroopers switch roles as they age—patrol guards today, death squad tomorrow.”
- [crow] Also, American crows hold grudges for years.  
  -> Also, the Empire holds grudges for years.
- [crow] Ravens—close cousins to crows—solve multi-step puzzles faster than many primates, so we’ve got cognitive backup if the numbers baffle anyone.”  
  -> “Lightsabers—iconic weapons of the Jedi—slice through durasteel with ease, so we’ve got thermal backup if the defenses baffle anyone.”
- [bee] “New research shows honeybees can count landmarks up to four; if your route software stops at three turns, it’s underutilizing insect precedent.”  
  -> “New research shows Jedi can sense disturbances up to four sectors away; if your navicomputer stops at three jumps, it’s underutilizing Force precedent.”
- [bee] “Worker bees tilt the hive floor by precise fractions to evaporate nectar faster, creating airflow.”  
  -> “Imperial officers adjust the thermal exhaust by precise fractions to vent heat faster, creating airflow.”
- [crow] If it overshoots I’m blaming your crows.”  
  -> If it overshoots I’m blaming your droids.”
- [crow] And common ravens hide food behind stones or sticks.  
  -> And Rebel spies hide codes behind stones or sticks.
- [bee] Scout bees argue about diner reviews via waggle, majority rules—works for weddings.”  
  -> Stormtroopers argue about diner reviews via blaster, majority rules—works for weddings.”
